name: dialog-11
description: Multi-step onboarding dialog with progress, back and next navigation.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { BellRing as BellRingIcon, LayoutDashboard as LayoutDashboardIcon, Users as UsersIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/dialog" import { Progress } from "@workspace/ui/components/progress" const steps = [ { icon: LayoutDashboardIcon, title: "Browse Designali blocks", body: "Pick from 460+ production-ready blocks built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS.", }, { icon: UsersIcon, title: "Grab icons and logos", body: "Install @designali/icons and @designali/logos in one command.", }, { icon: BellRingIcon, title: "Ship your site", body: "Deploy to Vercel and go from design to code in a day.", }, ] export default function OnboardingStepsDialog() { const [step, setStep] = React.useState(0) const current = steps[step]! const last = step === steps.length - 1 return ( open && setStep(0)}> }>Take the tour

Step {step + 1} of {steps.length}

{current.title} {current.body} }>Skip
{last ? ( }>Get started ) : ( )}
) }
